title: [AINews] Gemini 4 Neon: GDM's Opus/Sol Contender
author: swyx .ai
description: November 18, 2026 — Google’s middle tier scores 61 on the Intelligence Index. Plus, Anthropic prices its IPO at $83.
summary: Google DeepMind shipped Gemini 4 Neon , its fourth Gemini 4 model in about seven weeks. If you’re confused about the naming, you’re not alone; the 1.5 month old Argon is now retired , the old Pro and Flash from Gemini 1-3 are dead, and if you’re thinking the names are based on atomic weights, Neon (10), the midtier model is faster/cheaper than Carbon (6).
